data.one_liner: Dart bindings for the JavaScript Fetch API, enabling web‑only HTTP requests with streaming and abort support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart wrapper around the browser Fetch API, exposing full request options, AbortController cancellation, and response streaming as text, Blob or Uint8List streams. It also offers utilities to check streaming capability and handle redirects.
use_when: You need fine‑grained control over fetch options on web platforms
You require streaming request or response bodies in a web app
You want to cancel in‑flight requests via AbortController
avoid_when: Running on mobile, desktop, or server where Fetch API isn’t available
You need a cross‑platform HTTP client with retries, interceptors, or advanced features
strengths: Full coverage of Fetch API options
WASM‑ready and works with JavaScript interop
weaknesses: Web‑only; no support for non‑web platforms
Limited higher‑level features like retries or interceptors
Breaking API changes between minor versions

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Cross‑platform HTTP client with a simple API and no web‑only constraints

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature‑rich HTTP client with interceptors, retries, and support for all Flutter platforms
